notes: This is a passive, transformer-tapped 70V/100V/8Ω flush-mount ceiling loudspeaker (5.25\" woofer + 2.25\" Twiddler driver, 100W/400W peak, 8Ω nominal bypassed). It has no amplifier, no active electronics, and no mains power input — it draws audio/speaker-level signal through its single input terminal, which doubles as the power path. The official Bose data sheet specifies the connector only as a \"three-terminal barrier strip\" accepting 18-14 AWG wire; there is no barrier-strip/bare-wire id in the provided connector enum, so \"euroblock\" was chosen as the closest terminal-block-style analog. No bandwidth/version grade applies (analog speaker-level audio, not a graded digital/AV interface), so grade is omitted. Rack units omitted (ceiling-mounted, not rack equipment). Source: official Bose Professional technical data sheet (pro.Bose.com / assets.boseprofessional.com), confirmed directly via PDF fetch.

ports.name: Input
ports.note: Three-terminal barrier strip (screw-terminal block), not a Euroblock/Phoenix connector per se — closest id available. Accepts 18 AWG to 14 AWG wire. Speaker-level input wired in parallel with the internal 70V/100V step-down transformer (with tap selector) or usable direct at 8 ohms low-impedance; no dedicated line-level or power connector on this passive ceiling loudspeaker.
